stories.label: Iran war Day 23: US bounties on Iranian leaders, Iraq warned on Kurdish involvement
stories.summary: Day 23: US puts $10M bounties on Iran's new supreme leader and IRGC officials — unprecedented targeting of sitting government. Iraq warns Kurdish authorities not to be drawn in as US seeks staging ground. War widening through financial, intelligence, and proxy channels alongside continued bombing.

stories.label: Hormuz economic crisis: IEA activates emergency oil reserves for fourth time in history
stories.summary: IEA activates strategic petroleum reserves — only the 4th time in history (Gulf War, Libya, Russia-Ukraine, now). War has broken global oil supply enough to trigger crisis-level intervention. Rich countries draw down reserves while Global South gets no relief.
